tools.name: software-security_sbom-vulnerability-match
tools.description: Parse a CycloneDX or SPDX SBOM, or a component list, and classify each exact package version against OSV advisories as affected, unaffected, or unknown. A similar package name is not a match. Price $0.08 USDC. POST /api/v1/software-security/sbom-vulnerability-match. An unpaid call returns the x402 p

tools.name: software-security_dependency-risk-report
tools.description: Summarise affected, unaffected, and unknown OSV advisory counts for each exact dependency version. No risk score is calculated. Price $0.08 USDC. POST /api/v1/software-security/dependency-risk-report. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: software-security_kev-exposure-check
tools.description: Compare exact dependency versions with OSV advisories and the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. A KEV entry is reported only when that CVE applies to the same package and version range. Price $0.06 USDC. POST /api/v1/software-security/kev-exposure-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 p

tools.name: software-security_license-compatibility-check
tools.description: Read licence identifiers declared in the SBOM or published by npm, PyPI, crates.io, or RubyGems, then compare them with the caller allow and deny policy. Missing identifiers are not treated as compatible. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/software-security/license-compatibility-check. An unpaid call re

tools.name: software-security_malicious-dependency-check
tools.description: Look for OSV malicious-package advisories and npm compromise heuristics (typosquat distance to popular names, very new packages, few versions, missing repository). Signals are not proof of malware; no advisory does not mean the package is safe. Price $0.06 USDC. POST /api/v1/software-security/malici

tools.name: software-security_release-precheck
tools.description: Combine exact-version OSV matches, CISA KEV exposure, licence policy, and malicious-package advisories into one release report. The report never approves a release. Price $0.15 USDC. POST /api/v1/software-security/release-precheck. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "software-security" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: software-security_sbom-vulnerability-match, software-security_kev-exposure-check, software-security_license-compatibility-check, software-security_malicious-dependency-check · Public sink: software-security_sbom-vulnerability-match, software-security_dependency-risk-report, software-security_kev-exposure-check, software-security_license-compatibility-check, software-security_malicious-dependency-check, software-security_release-precheck · Destructive: software-security_sbom-vulnerability-match, software-security_dependency-risk-report, software-security_kev-exposure-check, software-security_license-compatibility-check, software-security_malicious-dependency-check, software-security_release-precheck.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
